text:
Priya (Finance): Quick sync from the billing postmortem: we need owners for three remediation items — ingest backfill, invoice corrections for impacted customers, and telemetry/runbook fixes. Reply with name + ETA.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): I can own the ingest backfill and corrected token computations. Need raw ingress logs and tokenizer map. Dry-run today, final CSV by tomorrow EOD.

Maya (Billing): I will own invoice adjustments and credits. Blocked until Ashwin provides final deltas. Target to send corrected invoices before next billing cycle; need numbers by Tue 17:00 PT.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I will own alerting and the operational runbook updates. Plan: add ingestion-lag alert (threshold 10m), add a pre-apply sanity check for deltas >3%, and create a dashboard panel. PR by Tue.

Leo (Platform): Investigated root cause: autoscaler flapping during a burst -> retry queue backlog. Short-term mitigation: set min-replicas=3 for metering-api and enable token-bucket backpressure. I'll open a PR and schedule a rolling update.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-4922 created: "Metering ingestion backfill and billing corrections" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): For customer comms: concise apology, credit amount, and appendix with calculations. I'll draft the template and loop in Legal. Draft due Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Export started to s3://redwood-metering/exports/1812345678-logs.tar.gz. Planned backfill command: 
```
metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas_1812345678.csv
```
Dry-run then apply in maintenance window.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Proposed maintenance window Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC. I will be on-call and watch tail latency + token delta spikes.

Maya (Billing): Preliminary estimate: ~$8.9k credit across two accounts. Will hold until Ashwin's CSV.

Priya (Finance): Action summary for tracker: Ashwin = backfill + final counts (target Wed EOD), Sam = alerts/runbook (PR by Tue), Leo = infra fixes (PR by Mon), Maya = invoices + comms (Tue COB). I'll update postmortem doc and ping execs after final numbers.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Dry-run complete, uploaded s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1812345678-deltas.csv. A few customers show >5% delta; flagging for manual review before apply.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ack. I'll add the sanity-check step to the runbook so billing only gets deltas after verification.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-4922 check-in in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks all. Ping me if you need invoice templates or billing console access.

Priya (Finance): Great progress — Ill consolidate owners & dates in the postmortem and schedule a 15-min exec update after we confirm final numbers.
